scores.label: A
scores.note: 2-10 are adjectives (hesitant, unsure, uncertain, wary, skeptical, insecure, self-doubtful, cynical, distrustful) and are ungrammatical before 'himself'; 9 cynical and 10 distrustful also shift meaning

scores.label: B
scores.note: 1 'hesitating himself' is ungrammatical (hesitate is intransitive); 2 uncertain, 3 distrustful, 4 perplexed, 5 bewildered, 7 hesitant are adjectives ungrammatical before 'himself'; 4 and 5 also wrong meaning

scores.label: C
scores.note: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 include 'himself'/'about himself' and double it in place; 5 'hesitating' is intransitive, ungrammatical before 'himself'; 7 'worrying himself' means making himself anxious, not self-doubt; 9 'uncertain' is an adjective, ungrammatical before 'himself'
